Generate Ridge Plots to Visualize the Distribution of Abundances of Taxa

Source: R/Ridge_Plot_it.R
ridge_plot_it.Rd

This function rarefies the data, performs proportion transformation, gloms and prunes taxa, and generates ridge plots to visualize the distribution of relative abundances of taxa.

ridge_plot_it(physeq, taxrank = "Genus", rarefaction_depth = NULL, top_n = 10)

Arguments

physeq

A phyloseq object containing the taxonomic and abundance data.

taxrank

A character string specifying the taxonomic rank to use for glomming and plotting. Default is "Genus".

rarefaction_depth

A numeric value specifying the rarefaction depth. If NULL, it is set to 90% of the minimum sample sum. Default is NULL.

top_n

An integer specifying the number of top taxa to include in the plot. Default is 10.

Value

A ggplot2 object representing the ridge plot of the distribution of relative abundances of taxa.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
if (interactive()) {
  ridgeP <- ridge_plot_it(spiked_16S, taxrank = "Family", top_n = 10)
  print(ridgeP) + my_custom_theme()
}
} # }
